method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (16 Oct 2026): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO/laws.sg, and JP NTA. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 16 Oct 2026: Sep Inclusive Framework announcement page fetched successfully (Admin Guidance / GIR / Full Legislative Review — already catalogued). Official OECD STTR announcement for Romania's 2 Oct 2026 ratification fetched and confirmed — added as oecd-2026-10-02-romania-sttr-ratification (STTR not modelled). Central Record PDF fetched; CreationDate still 15 May 2026 (already catalogued as oecd-2026-05-central-record). No other post-11 Sep Pillar Two model-rules releases found beyond this STTR deposit.
coverage.HK: Checked 16 Oct 2026: IRD What's New fetched — newest entries are 14 Oct CDTA-gazettal press release and 12 Oct fraud alert; no Pillar Two entries since the 8 Jun 2026 GIR XML update already catalogued. IRD GMT/HKMTT page fetched — Phase 2 of the Pillar Two Portal still stated as Q4 2026. No new official Pillar Two developments.
coverage.SG: Checked 16 Oct 2026: IRAS GloBE/DTT page fetched (Side-by-Side / Substance-based Tax Incentive Safe Harbour / QTI list still present; no new official release beyond the 6 Oct Bill passage). MOF newsroom fetched — posts after 6 Oct are non-Pillar Two (Temasek etc.). laws.sg still shows Finance (Income Taxes) Bill (2026) with reader label 'As enacted' (updated mid-Oct) but SSO Acts-Supp browse via search/curl showed no Finance (Income Taxes) Act 2026 gazette/assent page; SSO continues to host Bill No. 22/2026. Nothing new since the 6 Oct parliamentary passage already catalogued.
coverage.JP: Checked 16 Oct 2026: NTA 新着情報 fetched — newest entries (13 Oct 酒類輸出動向; 1 Oct 文書回答) are unrelated to Pillar Two. The 趣旨説明 for the 7 Aug 2026 circular remains listed as 令和8年10月9日 (already catalogued as jp-2026-10-09). NTA グローバル・ミニマム課税 hub fetched — no new guidance links beyond Aug Q&A / Oct 趣旨説明 already in the file. KPMG Japan e-Tax News 13 Oct is secondary coverage of the same 趣旨説明. No further Pillar Two administrative guidance or GIR schema updates.
